items.title: Scripture
items.body: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever. — 1 Chronicles 16:34 (KJV)

items.title: Farmer's Almanac tip
items.body: Wild persimmons ripen in the fall and are best after they turn soft and wrinkled. Unripe persimmons are very astringent and will pucker your mouth.

items.title: Joke of the day
items.body: A rancher's wife asked, "Why do you keep that old truck when it doesn't run?" He said, "It still runs. It just doesn't like to."
